assumptions.claim: run_i is a single-cycle pulse to initiate one full Keccak round.
assumptions.cond: when run_i is used to start a round
assumptions.risk: Multiple unintended round initiations or FSM corruption if run_i stays high for more than one cycle.

assumptions.claim: rand_valid_i, rand_early_i, rand_data_i, and rand_aux_i must provide valid randomness when the round masking logic consumes them.
assumptions.cond: when internal masking is enabled and rand_valid_i is asserted
assumptions.risk: Insufficient entropy could weaken side-channel resistance and leak secret state.

assumptions.claim: clear_i must be asserted within the permitted lifecycle window to clear internal state.
assumptions.risk: State may not be cleared, leaving sensitive data accessible.

assumptions.claim: lc_escalate_en_i must be asserted according to system lifecycle policy to trigger security escalation.
assumptions.risk: Escalation may be missed, leaving the module in an insecure state.

assumptions.claim: The message feed producer must respect the ready/valid handshake; data_i is only valid when valid_i is high and ready_o is asserted in the same cycle.
assumptions.risk: Data corruption or loss of message bytes.

uncertain_points.claim: The logic driving sparse_fsm_error_o, round_count_error_o, and rst_storage_error_o is not present; error detection behavior is unknown.
uncertain_points.risk: Errors may not be detected or reported correctly, hiding FSM corruption or counter faults.

uncertain_points.claim: The exact protocol for ready_o (when it is de/asserted) is not defined; could lead to handshake deadlock.
uncertain_points.risk: Producer may stall indefinitely or overflow internal buffer.

uncertain_points.claim: rand_aux_i may be unused inside the module; its purpose is unclear from the interface alone.
uncertain_points.risk: If unused, it may be left floating or tied, causing synthesis warnings but no functional risk.

uncertain_points.claim: The relative timing of run_i pulse and clear_i assertion could conflict, potentially clearing state during an active round.
uncertain_points.cond: when clear_i is asserted while a round is in progress
uncertain_points.risk: Unpredictable intermediate state, possibly leaking partial digest or causing incorrect output.
